old_problem: The historical review treated the title's subsystem and command as entirely unknown. IPMI 2.0 sections 31.12-31.13 define Get/Set Auxiliary Log Status, MCA and OEM1/OEM2 type selectors, the MCA timestamp/count vector, the OEM timestamp/IANA/status vector and exact readback. What remains Project-specific is which optional log types and setter are implemented, the actual auxiliary-log state, and—for OEM types—the registered IANA owner and its eight-byte status schema. Those bounded inputs do not justify leaving standard semantics Pending.
disposition_reason: Enumerate log types 00h MCA, 01h OEM1 and 02h OEM2 with Get 0Ah/5Ah, then for each supported and truthfully controllable type use standard Set 0Ah/5Bh with the exact 9-byte MCA or 16-byte OEM vector. Require reserved type bits zero, timestamp/count or IANA/status data backed by the real auxiliary log and approved owner schema, exact 5Ah readback, downstream consistency and exact baseline restore. Set is optional even when Get exists; unsupported/N/A needs authoritative completion/capability evidence. Never invent OEM bytes, manufacture an MCA count, clear/disable logs, overwrite incident evidence, retry automatically or claim completion/readback that contradicts the underlying log.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1075-1078, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Related OOB rows 1203-1205 were directly read; Set OOB row 1204 / variant 0e52013e574e83fd remains separate. Formal queue sequence 72 was independently verified as row 1078 / variant 9d062674246f0ffb.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Get Auxiliary Log Status to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd5Ah and Set Auxiliary Log Status to Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Bh. The title is therefore a standard command identity, not an undefined OEM operation.
Sections 31.12-31.13 define Log Type low nibble 00h=MCA, 01h=OEM1 and 02h=OEM2 with high nibble reserved zero. Other selectors are reserved and a nonzero completion is required for unsupported types.

For MCA, Set request data is one type byte, four-byte IPMI timestamp and four-byte entry count, both multi-byte values least-significant byte first; Ffff_ffffh means count unspecified. Get returns the same status shape.

For OEM1/OEM2, Set request data is one type byte, four-byte timestamp, three-byte OEM IANA Enterprise Number least-significant byte first and eight OEM-defined status bytes. The standard defines framing but not the OEM byte semantics, so an authoritative IANA-matched OEM schema is mandatory and cannot be guessed.

Set is optional and cannot be implemented without Get, while Get may exist without Set or status may be updated only through a private mechanism. A valid Get therefore proves neither Set support nor writability; per-type N/A requires command/platform evidence.

The status is metadata describing a real MCA or OEM auxiliary log. Arbitrarily changing its timestamp, count, IANA owner or status would mislead remote software and may hide or fabricate diagnostics. Each target vector must correspond to an actual isolated test-log state and be verified against that log, not merely echoed by Get.

The MCA structure is standardized, but applicability and a safe alternate state still require the platform's real MCA-log producer. OEM types additionally require the IANA owner and its 8-byte contract. These are Project runtime prerequisites under ED-03/ED-34, not unresolved command semantics.

ED-03 separates standard and OEM data; ED-13/ED-15 govern unsupported/N/A and exact criteria; ED-17 preserves log evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set Auxiliary Log Status (IB Storage 0Ah/5Bh) typed MCA/OEM readback and restore
test_case.purpose: For every implemented and owner-approved auxiliary log type, set a truthful MCA or OEM status vector over the local interface, prove exact standard Get readback and consistency with the underlying log, then restore its complete baseline without clearing, disabling or falsifying diagnostic evidence or conflating the OOB variant.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware and local IPMI system interface; 0Ah/5Ah enumeration results for types 00h-02h and authoritative per-type Set 5Bh support/writability evidence
Complete raw/decoded baseline for every supported type plus the corresponding MCA/OEM auxiliary-log evidence, ownership, incident/compliance hold status and exact baseline restore vector

For MCA: authoritative producer, valid alternate log state, IPMI timestamp and 32-bit count oracle; for OEM1/OEM2: registered IANA Enterprise Number and versioned owner specification for all eight status bytes

Isolated test-log workflow or owner-approved truthful state transition, downstream consumer/alert inventory, containment window and proof that the status change cannot hide or fabricate production diagnostics
Versioned in-band 0Ah/5Bh runner and 0Ah/5Ah parser with length/endian/reserved checks, one type at a time, immediate confirmations, exact restore and zero automatic retries
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED AUXILIARY-LOG STATUS PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Preserve SEL, MCA/OEM auxiliary logs and consumer/audit baselines; do not clear or disable any log. Query 0Ah/5Ah for selectors 00h,01h,02h individually and record supported baseline vectors. For one supported type at a time, require authoritative Set support and an actual isolated/approved underlying-log transition whose truthful TARGET status is known. MCA TARGET is `[00 TS0 TS1 TS2 TS3 COUNT0 COUNT1 COUNT2 COUNT3]`; OEM TARGET is `[TYPE TS0 TS1 TS2 TS3 IANA0 IANA1 IANA2 STATUS0..STATUS7]`; all values are little-endian where specified and type high nibble is zero. Validate the vector against the actual log and downstream containment, display baseline/target/effect/restore for immediate approval, then send exactly once over `-I open` Storage 0Ah/5Bh [TARGET]. Require completion 00h, Get 0Ah/5Ah [TYPE] exact equality and an independent comparison to the underlying auxiliary log/consumer state. Send the exact BASE vector once, require Get equality and baseline-log consistency before the next type. Unsupported Set/Get is per-type N/A only from authoritative evidence. Never send a reserved type, guess IANA/OEM status, synthesize an MCA count without a log event, clear evidence, retry or continue after failed restore.
test_case.expected_result: For each supported approved type, the correctly sized Set returns completion 00h; Get returns an exact field-for-field TARGET with reserved bits clean, correct little-endian values and—on OEM types—the approved IANA and eight-byte schema. The status matches the actual underlying auxiliary log and causes only allowed consumer behavior. Restore returns 00h, Get equals the full BASE vector and log/consumer consistency is restored. Unsupported type/Set is capability-backed N/A. Length/endian/schema mismatch, echo inconsistent with the real log, fabricated/hidden evidence, unexpected alert, nonzero completion for a required path or incomplete restore is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant, correct 0Ah/5Bh and 5Ah pairing, supported type, exact 9-byte MCA or 16-byte OEM request, authoritative underlying-log semantics, completion plus readback plus independent log consistency, and exact restore. TBD-only execution, command success/readback alone, reserved types/bits, guessed OEM bytes/IANA, arbitrary MCA count/timestamp, cleared/disabled logs, OOB evidence substituted for this IB identity, automatic retry or incomplete restore cannot pass. N/A requires per-type or setter unsupported evidence, not assumption from a modern non-Itanium platform.
safety_gate: Use only the local interface for this IB identity; row 1204 OOB and the separate Get identities remain distinct coverage.
Preserve every diagnostic and audit source and check incident/compliance holds. Never test by clearing, disabling or falsifying a live MCA/OEM log.
Use only a truthful status produced by an isolated test-log transition or other explicitly approved underlying state. Get echo without source-log agreement is a FAIL.
For OEM types, require the exact registered IANA and versioned eight-byte schema. Unknown ownership or any undefined byte makes that type NOT READY.
Change one supported type at a time, keep independent observation live and precompute its exact baseline vector. Stop immediately on completion, readback, source-log or consumer mismatch.
No automatic retry. If status diverges, restore BASE once only when safe, preserve all logs and hand unresolved recovery to the auxiliary-log owner; do not clear evidence or reset the BMC.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; official 5Ah/5Bh authority; distinct row-1204 OOB Source Key/variant
Per-type Get support results, raw/decoded baselines, Set support/writability evidence and underlying MCA/OEM log/owner identity
Approved MCA timestamp/count oracle or OEM IANA/schema/status vector, isolated state transition and downstream containment analysis
Versioned runner hash, immediate confirmation, redacted exact Set request/completion and field-by-field Get comparison
Independent underlying-log/consumer consistency plus exact baseline restore/readback and preserved diagnostic/audit health
Per-type PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and engineer verdict, explicitly recording no log mutation or DUT action by the review agent
test_case.recovery: Before each type, retain the complete Get baseline and underlying auxiliary-log evidence and precompute the exact 5Bh BASE vector. On target completion/readback/source-log mismatch, stop consumers and further types, preserve all diagnostic evidence and send BASE once only if the owner-approved recovery says it cannot hide an intervening real log update. If a real new log entry occurred, do not overwrite its truthful status with stale BASE; hand reconciliation to the log owner. Verify 5Ah and underlying-log consistency. Never clear/disable logs, cold-reset or automatically retry.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.12-31.13/Tables 31-12 and 31-13 plus Appendix G define Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ah/5Bh, MCA/OEM selectors, timestamp/count or IANA/eight-status-byte framing, readback and the optional relationship between Get and Set.

project_authority: Auxiliary-log/BMC owners identify supported types and setter behavior, provide truthful MCA state or IANA-matched OEM schema/data, approve isolated transitions, consumer containment and restore, and issue verdicts. They cannot approve guessed OEM fields, fabricated log metadata, live evidence suppression, Get-only assumption of Set support, log clearing, automatic retry or OOB substitution.
